title: Capability Development Lead
description:
**Job Description**

Have you set the course for the future? We’ll give you the green light!

Because at Frauscher, we always have our eyes firmly fixed on progress. Let’s embark on this journey together! Our agility and enthusiasm for new things are reflected in our innovative technologies and services – and, of course, also in our corporate culture. Join Frauscher now and start your career journey with the technology leader!

At Frauscher, we are dedicated to delivering the world’s most reliable train detection and wayside object control solutions. Our industry leading field elements, software, connectivity and data access solutions, combined with smart life cycle services, ensure system critical components are operational and provide the information rail operators need to maximise the safety, efficiency and capacity of their networks. We provide the trusted foundation operators need to run their rail networks, being **"Your partner for confidence."**

**Role Purpose**

The Capability Development Lead will drive the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of internal learning, capability development, and competence management initiatives across the organization. Working with and reporting to Global Head of Academy, role is responsible for building structured learning journeys, strengthening technical and functional competencies, supporting leadership development initiatives, and fostering a culture of continuous learning that enables business growth and operational excellence.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and manage organization-wide capability development initiatives aligned with business priorities.
* Develop structured learning pathways, competency frameworks, and certification programs for technical, functional, and professional roles.
* Work with Global Head of Academy to partner with business leaders, subject matter experts, HR, and regional teams to identify capability gaps and learning needs.
* Lead the design and deployment of instructor-led, virtual, blended, and digital learning programs.
* Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of internal training programs, including planning, execution, evaluation, and continuous improvement.
* Drive knowledge capture and knowledge management initiatives to preserve critical organizational expertise.
* Support onboarding and role-based development programs for new employees.
* Develop assessment methodologies to measure competence, learning effectiveness, and capability maturity.
* Monitor learning analytics, competency metrics, and training KPIs to provide actionable insights.
* Manage technical learning content development and ensure content remains current and aligned with evolving business requirements.
* Promote a culture of continuous learning through innovative learning interventions and digital learning solutions.
* Collaborate with the Global Academy team to continuously enhance learning processes and governance.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Technology, or a related discipline.
* Certification in Learning & Development, Instructional Design, or Capability/ Talent Development is desirable.

**Experience**

* 7–8 years of experience in Learning & Development, Capability Development, Competency Management, Technical Training, or Organizational Development.
* Experience in engineering, manufacturing, industrial technology, rail, automation, or a similar technical industry is preferred.
* Experience of working with Learning Management Systems (LMS) and digital learning platforms.
* Exposure to competency frameworks and certification programs is highly desirable.

In short: People who aspire for more – individuals who are willing to contribute their passion, creativity and skills to help advance our shared vision. Are you bursting with curiosity and creativity? Do you have brilliant ideas and want to set the course for the future, today? If so, embark on your Frauscher journey with us!

 **Additional Information**

**What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First?**

At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job - it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it - for our clients and each other.

If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you.

**Who are we?**

Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. With roots that date back to George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison, and Louis Faiveley, Wabtec has always built technologies and implemented solutions for a variety of sectors that are critical to meeting the needs of customers and governments alike.

Our global team of about 30,000 employees worldwide delivers performance that moves the world forward. We’re lifelong learners, obsessed with better. Learn more at www.WabtecCorp.com.

**Culture powers us and the possibilities.**

We believe the best ideas come from a mix of experiences and backgrounds. At Wabtec, we strive every day to create a place where everyone belongs. We’re building a culture where leadership, inclusion and your unique perspective fuel progress.

We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome talent of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including race, gender, age, disability, veteran status and more.

Need accommodation? Just let us know - we’ve got you.

title: Analyst, HR Operations
description:

* Consistently exhibits high levels of discretion, integrity, and confidentiality
* Ability to work under pressure and independently, following tight deadlines and an agile approach.

title: Global L&D Senior Coordinator
description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

The Global L&D Senior Coordinator role sits at the intersection of reporting and analytics, audit and governance, and change management. This role owns end-to-end transformation, process redesign, audit, and governance across our entire curriculum, learning journeys, and programs, using data-driven insight and structured governance frameworks to ensure consistency, quality, and continuous improvement and plays a critical part in driving L&D transformation through evidence-based decision-making

Your key responsibilities:

* Reporting & Analytics: Own the end-to-end reporting and analytics engine for transformation and learning delivery: build and maintain dashboards tracking milestone progress, risks, variances, and engagement trends across projects and learning journeys
* Audit & Governance: Lead process audit and governance across the full curriculum, learning journeys, and program lifecycle. Design and enforce quality control frameworks, conduct periodic audits for consistency and compliance, and own the continuous improvement roadmap that emerges from audit findings.
* Project & Transformation Delivery: Manage end-to-end strategic transformation initiatives with a governance lens, tracking milestones, dependencies, and scope against a structured reporting cadence. Coordinate cross-functional workstreams and escalate risks or variances through formal governance reviews with the core team.
* Stakeholder Management: Partner with a wide range of stakeholders, including senior leaders, using reporting outputs and audit insights as the backbone of influence and alignment, ensuring transparency and accountability across the business.
* Tools & Platforms: Apply strong technical expertise across learning platforms and AI tools (SABA, Docebo, SFMC, and others) primarily to extract, structure, and analyze data for reporting, audit trails, and governance documentation.
* Operations: Support the team on run-the-business activities and ad hoc projects as and when needed, stepping in flexibly to ensure continuity and momentum across priorities.

We are looking for someone who has the potential to fulfil the above, with genuine interest and passion for this topic. Someone who can handle uncertainty and help shape the future direction of the role.

What You'll Bring

* Proven Track Record: 10+ years of progressive experience in change, transformation, Operations redesign, with at least 4+ years spearheading large-scale digital or organizational transformation initiatives.
* Tech Savviness: Deep functional knowledge of modern HR/L&D systems (e.g., Workday Learning, Degreed, EdCast, Cornerstone) and automated content creation tools.
* Audit & Governance Expertise: Demonstrated experience designing or operating within audit, quality control, or governance frameworks, with a track record of turning findings into measurable process improvement
* Analytical Fluency: Comfortable working with large or messy data sets, building dashboards, and translating trends into clear recommendations for senior stakeholders
* Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

Who You'll Work With

A passionate and dedicated Learning & Development team, who are currently spread across the globe. You will be part of the Operations team that oversees the overall orchestration of Learning at BCG. As a complex matrix structured organization, you will work with broader L&D colleagues and other functional teams. You will establish strong relationships across our people functions and beyond to successfully learn, educate and influence others.

Additional info

You’re Good At

* Analytical & Strategic Thinking: Ability to synthesize complex data sets and business objectives into clear, decision-ready insights and capability strategies
* Governance & Rigor: Exceptional attention to detail and structured thinking, able to design audit frameworks and quality controls that hold up across a large, matrixed organization
* Influencing Through Evidence: Strong communication skills to build consensus among diverse, cross-functional stakeholders, using data and audit findings as the foundation for influence rather than authority alone
* Resilience & Agility: Comfortable navigating high ambiguity, shifting priorities, and large organizational matrix structures.
* Leading Change with Data: Skilled at driving large-scale process redesign and adoption, using reporting and audit insights to build the case for change and bringing stakeholders along through structured, evidence-based change management.

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Manager, TSG Data Engineering
description:
COMPANY PROFILE
  
  
Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.
  
  
Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefine industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes.
  
  
The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals - serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics - who support our offices globally. Our mantra of "shared innovation, seamless execution," underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.
  
  
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK
  
  
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.
  
  
Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH
  
  
This position works as a member of software development team focused exclusively on building and supporting Bain’s most strategic internal data. Team members work collaboratively to design, build and implement new features and functionality in their systems aimed at delivering the most value to Bain’s global users and supporting key business initiatives.
  
  
WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM
  
  
This position works as a member of Bain’s internal Software Development group directly supervising and supporting the Data engineers on a team. Individuals in this role would also be responsible for defining the on-going technical roadmap for the team and influencing the choice of technologies and frameworks implemented by the engineers.
  
  
WHAT YOU’LL DO
  
  
Technical Delivery (50%)
  

* Lead a scrum team developing and updating applications
* Lead the planning, testing and implementation of all production releases. Coordinate production releases between scrum teams across the product. Work with System Architect, Data Architect and engineering team members for the configuration and implementation of DevOps and Continues Integration.
* Encourage DevOps mindset within the engineering team and facilitates lean production, continuous integration and continuous deployment while working with the System Architect and engineering team members.
* Support the team in the evaluation and selection process of the 3rd part components/libraries/ tools together with the Systems Architect and Data Architect.
* Provide ongoing support for applications already in use. This includes problem diagnosis and resolution, ad hoc reporting support and database administration.
* Provide frequent updates regarding development issues to the TSG leadership and other groups as appropriate.
* Participate in product level Steering Committee meetings as appropriate.
* Provide technical leadership and facilitate cross-team communication across multiple product scrum teams.
* Ensure the proposed technical approaches meet the functional requirements and are in coordination with similar activities across the other product scrum teams. Provide guidance to the scrum team determining the need for new technologies based on the product backlog.

Team management (25%)
  

* Manage and supervise between 3-6 direct reports within the development team. These individuals are typically working on the team they directly support. Responsible for the individuals’ PD and career development.
* Participate in hiring of developers/ engineering team members.
* Support individual team members and provide technical input and mentorship to help the team deliver current work in the sprint. Assess and help them improve their engineering practices.
* Coach teams and individuals on their understanding of Agile methodologies and Agile practices improving their interactions and ensuring they have the right process and tools for their success.
* Promote practices which help with incremental delivery and continuous integration and remove any blockers from achieving incremental delivery.
* Work with the Scrum Master to identify teaching and learning opportunities for their direct reports and help the scrum team members to be more T-Shaped.

Strategy, planning and technology leadership (25%)
  

* Support the Scrum Master in improving delivery metrics like velocity, responsiveness, predictability, quality, etc.
* Advise business and technology partners on technology solutions leveraging emerging technologies and on mitigation of disruption risk.
* Prepare and maintain the long-term technology roadmap for the product based on the product vision. Work with the Product Owner, System Architect, Data Architect and engineering team members for its implementation.

ABOUT YOU
  

* Experience in software development including work on all aspects of the development life cycle.
* Solid understanding of Agile Methodology with experience in managing sprints/ scrums and user stories while using tools such as VSTS, Jira, etc.
* Experience architecting applications and working on enterprise-wide systems.
* Experience leading technical teams on small to medium size projects.
* Demonstrated record of strong performance in prior software development positions.
* Strong communication, time management and customer service skills.
* High performance and standards as demonstrated by academic or previous job experience.

**Data Engineering - Technical skills:**  

* Languages: SQL, PySpark, Python, Scala
* Data Storage & Analytics: Delta Lake, Unity catalog, Microsoft SQL Server, Azure SQL, Azure Data Lake, Blob Storage, etc.
* ETL Tools: Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory
* Cloud-based data warehouse and Lakehouse architectures on Microsoft Azure
* Cloud & Infrastructure: Azure Databricks, ADLS, ADF, Azure Logic app
* DevOps: Git, GitHub Actions, Terraform
* Visualization Tools: Tableau, Power BI, etc.

Experience
  

* 8-10 experience in software development including work on all aspects of the development life cycle.

Strong analytical skills and reporting capability.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

* Share lessons learned and best practices across functions and deployments
* Promote AI\-enabled ways of working and support the development of AI capabilities across Enterprise Services

**YOU’RE GOOD AT**

* Taking a hands\-on, roll\-up\-your\-sleeves approach to solving business problems using AI and automation
* Understanding operational processes and identifying practical opportunities to improve them through technology
* Translating business needs into scalable AI\-enabled solutions and workflows
* Working effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Driving adoption and change in complex, matrixed environments

* Strong understanding of Enterprise Services\-type processes, such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Real Estate, Travel, or other operational functions

You will work closely with Enterprise Services leadership, product and engineering teams, AI and Data functions, and operational stakeholders across BCG. ### **Job Title**

Rewards Services Partner, Central Team
### **Job Description**

**Are you ready to help build something new?**

At Philips, meaningful careers are built by stepping into opportunities that challenge you, broaden your perspective, and enable you to make an impact with care.


The Central Rewards Services team was established in August 2026 to bring together shared activities across M\&A, analytics, equity, mobility, business travel, and operations. By combining our expertise, we aim to increase agility and strengthen global consistency.


As a Rewards Services Partner, you will join us at an important stage in our journey. You will help shape how the team works, contribute across disciplines, and grow your expertise beyond a single Rewards specialization.


**In this role, you have the opportunity to..**

Help build the future of Rewards Services at Philips. You will combine ownership of Global Mobility support for the APAC region with broader contributions to global Rewards processes, including annual compensation rounds, market benchmarking, analytics, and cross\-functional improvement initiatives.


This is intentionally a diverse and evolving role. The Central Rewards Services team is new, and not every responsibility or way of working has been fully defined. You will have the space to bring ideas, test better approaches, and take ownership where your experience, curiosity, and energy can create value.


You will work with specialists across the global Rewards landscape, learn from different disciplines, and help connect activities that have traditionally been managed separately. In doing so, you will strengthen both the employee experience and the consistency and effectiveness of our Rewards services.


The role is an opportunity to broaden your career as a Rewards professional while making a visible contribution to the success of a new global team.


**Your role**

* Own and coordinate Global Mobility activities for the APAC region, providing clear guidance and a consistent experience for employees and stakeholders.
* Contribute to global Rewards cycles, including annual compensation review processes, with a focus on accurate preparation, effective coordination, and high\-quality delivery.
* Support market benchmarking and Rewards analysis, translating data into clear insights that enable informed decisions.
* Work across Central Rewards Services activities, including equity, business travel, M\&A, analytics, operations, and Rewards Excellence, based on business priorities and team needs.
* Help design and embed new ways of working that reduce duplication, improve agility, and strengthen global consistency.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, clarify ownership, improve service quality, and create an even better employee and stakeholder experience.
* Build strong partnerships with a multitude of stakeholders from a great variety of functions within the organisation to deliver connected solutions.
* Use data, technology, and AI responsibly to improve insights, efficiency, and service delivery.
* Share knowledge, learn from colleagues across disciplines, and contribute to building capability within the Central Rewards Services team and the wider Rewards community.
* Take ownership beyond established boundaries when new priorities emerge, balancing flexibility with sound judgment and reliable delivery.

**The impact you can make**

Your contribution will go beyond delivering individual processes. You will help turn a newly established team into a connected and trusted global partner by:


* Ensuring a consistent, employee\-focused Global Mobility experience across the APAC region.
* Helping global Rewards processes run smoothly and deliver reliable outcomes.
* Connecting expertise and activities across Central Rewards Services so that work is performed where it creates the most value.
* Bringing forward practical ideas and turning them into improvements that can be scaled globally.
* Helping build a team culture based on collaboration, curiosity, accountability, and continuous learning.

**You're the right fit if you have:**

* A Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.
* Experience in Global Mobility, Compensation, Rewards, HR Operations, or a related discipline.
* Interest in broadening your expertise across multiple Rewards areas rather than remaining within one specialization.
* Analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to turn data and complexity into clear insights and practical actions.
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills in a global, matrixed organization.
* The ability to organize priorities, deliver reliably, and adapt when business needs change.
* A continuous\-improvement mindset and the confidence to question existing approaches constructively.
* Curiosity, creativity, and flexibility, together with a willingness to step outside your comfort zone.
* The judgment and discretion required when working with confidential employee and business information.
* AI literacy and an interest in using technology to improve how Rewards services are delivered.

**You will thrive in this role if you...**

* Are energized by the opportunity to help create, not only to maintain.
* Can bring structure to ambiguity without waiting for every detail to be defined.
* See change as an opportunity to learn, contribute, and improve.
* Enjoy moving between regional delivery, global processes, analysis, and project work.
* Build trust through collaboration, openness, and follow\-through.
* Want to broaden your Rewards expertise and help a new team become a success.

**How we work together**  

We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office\-based teams, this means working in\-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full\-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.  



  

**About Philips**  

Are you ready to do the work of your life to help the lives of others? Learn more about our business , discover our rich and exciting history and learn more about our purpose .
  

If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care .

title: Global Product Senior Analyst
description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


The HR Digital Product Portfolio is one of the largest and most dynamic portfolios within BCG’s Digital Products Organization, enabling technology across BCG’s HR and People functions. Within the Talent Acquisition Product Team, the Candidate Selection squad supports the products and capabilities that underpin how BCG assesses and selects candidates.

  

As a Senior Product Analyst, you will work closely with the Product Owner, business teams, technology teams, QA, and external vendors to shape effective product solutions. You will independently explore business needs, challenge assumptions, and translate complex requirements into clear, actionable solutions, with the Product Owner providing direction and final sign\-off where appropriate.

  

* Lead and facilitate requirements discussions with business and technology teams to understand problems, user needs, business value, and the wider impact of proposed changes.
* Document clear product requirements in Jira, translating business needs into user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, functional requirements, use cases, and solution options.
* Challenge requests constructively, identifying assumptions, dependencies, risks, unintended consequences, and alternative approaches before solutions are agreed.
* Co\-create solutions with business, technology, QA, and vendor teams, helping bridge functional and technical considerations and supporting the Product Owner with prioritization and delivery readiness.
* Build deep product knowledge and take accountability for changes from requirements through test\-scenario definition, validation, deployment readiness, and rollout.
* Prioritize and investigate assigned production issues, identify likely root causes, and bring the right squad, vendor, or technology expertise together to drive effective resolution.
* Support successful adoption of new functionality by preparing release notes and partnering with Learning and Development and Process Enablement colleagues on user guidance and learning materials where needed.
* Contribute to cross\-functional initiatives and broader Talent Acquisition Product Team priorities as opportunities and business needs evolve.
* Build adjacent product and technical skills, including taking on straightforward SaaS configuration and functional enhancement activities where appropriate.

  

What You'll Bring

* 4\+ years of relevant experience in product analysis, business analysis, technology, operations, or a related field.
* Strong analytical and critical\-thinking skills, with confidence to challenge assumptions, identify downstream impacts, and recommend practical solutions.
* Experience eliciting, translating, and documenting business needs into user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, functional requirements, and use cases.
* Experience partnering with developers and engineers to bridge functional and technical requirements and translate business intent into implementation\-ready specifications.
* Experience partnering with QA teams to define test scenarios, validate system behaviour, investigate issues, and manage feedback through delivery.
* Experience working with SaaS products and external vendors, with an interest in developing hands\-on configuration and product administration capabilities.
* Strong working knowledge of Jira and Confluence; Talent Acquisition or HR technology experience is strongly preferred, while exposure to ServiceNow, APIs, integrations, MuleSoft, production support, system troubleshooting, or change management is beneficial.

  

Who You'll Work With


You’ll be part of the Candidate Selection squad within BCG’s global Talent Acquisition Product Team.

  

You’ll collaborate closely with Product Owners, engineers, developers, QA, Scrum Leads, SaaS Engineers, Talent Acquisition teams, and external vendors. Depending on the product or change, you may also partner with Legal, Data Protection, and Responsible AI teams.

  

The team works through close business and technology co\-creation, combining BCG\-built solutions with integrated SaaS platforms and strong vendor partnerships across a global network.

  

Additional info


At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

  

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

  

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.
